shared_tail.surface: عبيد الله بن عبد الله بن عتبة بن مسعود

notes: Layth is written again in the second branch and the names after it are written once, so they close both routes (rule 3); «أنهما قالا» makes the two Companions co-transmitters at the last level; «رجلا من الأعراب» is a person in the scene, not a link.
